meta.what: Every launchd job label whose program is on 27.0.1's system volume (or, for five under /Library/Apple, in its Data-volume template), on the furthest booted macOS 27.0.1-only root: where its program comes from, and whether it ran in one boot of that root.

evidence.measured: each program's architectures (the class column); and, per label, the job status in one boot: whether a process existed, shown by a process id, and any exit status
evidence.inferred: which binary each job was executing, for every label except launchd and xpcproxy: it follows from what was placed on disk, not from a hash taken inside the guest

meta.how: Class: each program's architectures were read path by path from Apple's 27.0.1 system volume on a Mac running 27.0.1; the programs of the five labels under /Library/Apple (four programs) were read from the Data-volume template in Apple's 27.0.1 image instead. State: the job table printed to the guest's serial console during one boot of about 1,000 seconds; 'ran' means a pid or an exit status appeared in some sample. On-demand jobs that were not needed in that window show as not started. Labels come from 27.0.1's launchd plists and the job tables of two boots of this root; states come from one of those boots. The counts are of labels, not programs: a program can serve more than one label.
meta.not_measured: Whether a job that ran did its work: 'ran' means a process existed. Which binary a job ran was hashed inside the guest only for launchd and xpcproxy; for the rest it is inferred from the placement records.
meta.left_out: What each count covers. Listed here: 421 labels; 388 of them were in that boot's job table and 118 ran, 15 of those with a nonzero exit status; the other 33 were not in that boot's job table at all and show as not started. Not listed: 31 labels that are not programs of 27's system volume or its Data-volume template (scripts, per-boot labels, the lab's own test jobs, and com.apple.MRTd, whose program 27.0.1's image does not contain); 23 of them were in the job table and 8 ran, all with exit status 0. So the whole job table of that boot was 411 labels, of which 126 ran, the figure the feature matrix gives. The 3 borrowed macOS 26 programs were replaced by 27's own in three later boots; their rows show the boot counted here.

classes.apple-27-x86_64: Apple's own 27.0.1 program, which still ships an x86_64 slice; run as Apple shipped it
classes.apple-27-arm64e-translated: Apple's own 27.0.1 program, shipped without an x86_64 slice (arm64e; arm64e and arm64 for the two programs behind the three XProtect labels); run under translation by the kernel's foreign-architecture exec route
classes.apple-27-lifted: Apple's own 27.0.1 arm64e program, recompiled to x86_64 by the project's lifter and linked against 27's x86_64 libraries
classes.borrowed-tahoe-x86_64: an x86_64 build of the same program from macOS 26 (Tahoe), used in the boot counted here; 27's own arm64e builds replaced all three in three later boots
classes.apple-27-flags-changed: Apple's own 27.0.1 file, bytes unchanged, file flags changed
